BackupEncryptedChunkV1.aad: canonical header digest + index + plaintext length

BackupEncryptedManifestV1.file_inventory: closed relative paths + size/digest; no secrets

PortableBackupSetManifestV1.created_at_utc: int canonical UTC whole seconds matching payload header

PortableBackupSetAuthV1.manifest_sha256: sha256 hex over exact canonical manifest bytes
PortableBackupSetAuthV1.tag_base64url: 32-byte HMAC tag encoded base64url without padding

PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1.encoding: SHA-256 over length-prefixed UTF-8/binary canonical tuple
PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1.purpose: stable non-secret identity for preview/replay revalidation of the complete set; never substitutes for cryptographic companion verification

RestorePreviewV1.verified_source_fingerprint: PortableBackupSetFingerprintV1 for portable or artifact SHA-256 for managed

rules: public header and detached companions contain no customer/domain content
backup key is independently random for every backup
managed backup key wrap uses independent DPAPI-protected installation backup-root key; portable wrap uses recovery-derived KEK
portable detached authenticity key uses separate HKDF info SOMA-BACKUP-PORTABLE-AUTH-V1 and is never the KEK
recovery secret is displayed/exported separately and never persisted in SOMA
portable set is valid only when payload, canonical manifest and authenticity companion all bind the same backup_id and verify together
wrong secret and authenticity/payload tamper are nondisclosing at user error detail level
